text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I made my way to Tokyo Racecourse to check on the debuting horse girls...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uwooooooooon!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You did your best in your debut race~!
I'm so movedーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I peeked over wondering what the commotion was... and it's just you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oooooon! Did you see that too, Brianーー?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Their first race ever...
Running their hearts out without crumbling under pressure――

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Everyone is so amazingggggーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't cry over every little thing.
That's a path everyone walks if they run in races.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Exactly! That's why it's so moving!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
M-M-My heart is pounding out of my chest...!
A-A-At times like this, on the palm of your hand...
On your palm... what are you supposed to write againーーー?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... If I'm like this in my debut race,
how will I ever handle the Derby...?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I somehow pulled myself together, but
the moment I stepped onto the turf, my mind went completely blank!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see girls running their debut race,
it brings back all the memories of how I felt back then!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uwoooooo~~~n!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Not everyone is like you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uwo... Huh, what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Just run for now."
That's all I was thinking about in my debut race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Looking back, there's no deep emotion or anything.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I see, you're totally different from me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...But, you know, from that point on, it's the same, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The same?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wanting to get faster, wanting to run in GⅠ races with rivals, not wanting to lose, wanting to win... wanting to make your dreams come true!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Those feelings keep piling up, clashing against each other and growing stronger!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: For those girls, and for us too! That's why it's the same!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I just hope whoever gets stronger like that can satisfy me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! New rivals will definitely show up!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's right, everyone's started running toward their dreams...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh... You're noisy to the bitter end.
